description: Submit jobs to an external workflows API and add their outputs as map layers.

descriptionFull.title: Submits jobs to the CZDT workflows API and adds vector outputs as layers when jobs complete. Endpoints are hardcoded in WorkflowsTool.js. The mission's 'workflows.baseUrl' selects between mock mode (empty or 'mock://') and direct-to-API mode; in direct mode the browser talks to the API with OAuth session cookies via 'Connect'.

example.pollIntervalMs: (int) how often to poll job status [default 2000]

name: Workflows

components.name: API Base URL
components.description: Origin of the CZDT workflows API (e.g. https://www.czdt.smce.nasa.gov). Required for the tool to function.

components.name: Poll Interval (ms)
components.description: How often the tool polls workflow job status.
